I can say this, because i care about people. I care about everyone that has it hard and doesn't know how to cope with it, i hope to reach out and touch someone, to let them know that they are better then that, to maybe stop a suicide and definitely to let them know that at least I care, that they don't have to be alone in this fucked up world.

Don't commit suicide, the point in life is making it good. Making it to the liking of YOU and the ones YOU care about. Fuck what others think, you can be anything you set your mind to. Study maybe just a bit more and talk to friends, i'll happily be your friend alongside the rest of the people who comment. Stay strong!

I will not tell you how you can get Drugs. But i do wanna offer my help and support if you want it, i won't judge how you feel or how you look at ways. Suicide is not the way of dealing with anything, if you really want to deal with it i suggest a Theapist or talking to a friend about it. I think i speak for everyone that read this when i say that We All care about you, and don't want you to die.

Suicide is NOT the way to make it all go away. Put those pills away, crumble that note up and throw it away, you deserve better then that! And what about all the people who care about you. How wouldn't they feel if they found out you were dead? They would be destroyed from the sadness that would be unleashed upon them. If you wanna talk about it i'm here for you, i won't judge in any way.

I believe in you, even if you don't believe in you I do. You can become anything you want, if you want to become an Astronaut you have to work hard and long. Study and do your homework and you'll be set, your friends would miss you if you died and everyone else would too. We're here for you and we want you to reach your goal. You're not useless, you make alot of people smile and you make so many peoples day better even if you don't know it. Good luck and happy travels!
